title: Chapter 430 Going To The Demon King’S Court
content:
Chapter 430 Going To The Demon King’S Court

Entering the Iron-Blooded City now is tantamount to exposing the ambition of Dahuai Territory, and standing directly on the opposite side of the demon clan. How can this facilitate Wang Shuo's alliance with the demon clan!

After having a feast with the two city lords and enjoying the song and dance performance, Wang Shuo declined the two city lords' invitation to stay longer and returned to Guancheng.

He originally wanted to pass through the Iron-Blooded City and directly enter the Demon Clan's territory, but then he thought it would be better to go secretly to avoid conflicts.

These two city lords had long lost their intention to go in, and were only thinking about maintaining the status. This kind of conservative thinking was even inferior to that of the Demon Emperor. Wang Shuo directly regarded them as negative teaching materials.

Back then, they must have been diligent and courageous people.

Maybe it's the comfortable life that has corroded their fighting spirit!

After returning to Guancheng, Wang Shuo immediately disguised himself and took Tianba and Gong Zheng out of the city.

There must be spies of the two city lords in Guan City, and Wang Shuo doesn't want them to know that he is going to the Monster Clan at this time.

Wang Shuo didn't even contact the generals at the border of the demon tribe, but entered the mountains alone.

The demon clan's territory is vast and sparsely populated, with desolate scenes everywhere, unlike the human clan's territory, which has dense towns.

Wang Shuo walked for nearly ten days, trying to avoid the territories of some big demons, and finally arrived at the royal court of the demon clan.

Wang Shuo traveled all the way, actually consciously surveying the terrain and analyzing the strength of the demon clan.

Entering the demon clan's capital, the three of them were immediately surrounded by demon beast guards.

Just kidding, three humans suddenly appeared in the hinterland of the demon clan. This was no different than a big demon entering the capital of the human clan. It was a big deal.

Seeing the strong aura emanating from the three people, these ordinary monsters did not act rashly.

In order to frighten Xiao Xiao, Wang Shuo directly activated the "doubling technique" and raised his aura to the level of a senior warrior.

At this time, a senior general from the Demon Clan stepped forward to inquire about the situation.

"I am the person in charge of the Great Sophora Territory. I was invited by the Demon Emperor to come for an appointment."

The demon general guarding the city did not dare to neglect, and immediately sent someone to ask the acting minister Noen.

In a mansion, Noen was shocked when he heard the report from his subordinates.

There are actually people who dare to come to the Demon Clan Royal Court.

Before, he had thought that Dahuai Territory would at best send people to tell the demon generals at the border about their decision.

He was even prepared that Da Huaiyu would not pay attention to this matter at all.

Unexpectedly, the other party actually dared to send people to the demon clan’s royal court.

Immediately, he rushed to the city gate.

I found that the opponent actually had the aura of a high-level warrior, and I didn't dare to underestimate him.

Now, in the Demon Clan Royal Court, apart from His Majesty the Demon Emperor, there are only three demon generals who can have the strength of high-level generals.

Of course, Norn itself also has the strength of a high-level warrior.

"I dare to ask, who are you from Dahuaiyu? Can you make the decision on Dahuaiyu's behalf?"

Wang Shuo looked at Noen and felt the powerful aura emanating from him. He thought to himself that he must be a person in charge.

At least, polite.

"I am Wang Shuo, one of the three county guards in Dahuai Region."

Noen was a little surprised. This county guard was really... so bold!

However, this courage really impressed him.

"Prefect Wang, since you are here, please invite me! Let's see if you have the courage to enter the city and meet His Majesty."

Wang Shuo was confused in his heart. I have traveled a long way to reach your lair. Is there anything that I dare not enter?

"Lead the way."

Wang Shuo said loudly, with a firm tone.
